name: Cetus Protocol
scope_note: Governance/incentive coin of the Cetus DEX on Sui; not a stablecoin, wrapped, staked, RWA or leveraged token. Listed on OKX spot 2023-05-10 and Binance spot (CETUSUSDT TRADING), far more than 90 days ago. A small Aptos deployment exists but holds well under 10% of supply (CoinGecko platforms list only Sui).

D1.value: Top-10 non-excluded holders (excluding only GoPlus-labelled Bitget 0x3a15 and Gate 0x62f3): the 8 unlabelled wallets in the GoPlus top 10 alone sum to 365.85M CETUS = 37.57% of CoinGecko circulating 973,913,043, above 35% before adding #9-#10. Driven by 0x7ab9 (22.58%), which looks like an exchange wallet but carries no label; without it the top 10 would be at most ~17.4%.

D2.value: Largest non-excluded holder 0x7ab9a6a7109dcb9cb357a109f32dfcc78a7aa2d6029084eb924d95133fc71cec holds 219,945,684.52 CETUS = 22.58% of circulating (>10%). It is a signing address (not an object/vesting contract), GoPlus tag null, no public label found by web search. It also holds 381.9M SUI, 142.5M WAL, 132.8M HAEDAL, 22.7M MMT and many small coins, and sweeps SUI/USDC/CETUS to 0x8b38f6e772... several times a week, which is exchange-like (possibly a CEX cold wallet), but that is a heuristic, not a label. If an explorer label confirms it as an exchange, the largest non-excluded holder becomes 0xdad8 at 3.75% and D2 would pass.
D2.source: GoPlus sui token_security; graphql.mainnet.sui.io address(0x7ab9){balance, balances, transactions}

D3.value: Under D5, unidentified wallets >=2% count as insiders: 0x7ab9 22.58% + 0xdad8 3.75% + 0x17d1 3.51% + 0xdc46 2.05% = 31.9% liquid (none is a vesting object) >20%. Excluding 0x7ab9 as an exchange it would be 9.3% (pass). Not fully worked up after the D2 hard fail.

D4.value: Insider-to-exchange flows over 90 days not traced (stopped after the D2 hard fail; no keyless labelled Sui explorer reachable: suiscan.xyz returned 407, Blockberry 401).

D5.value: Unidentified non-excluded wallets >=2%: 0x7ab9...1cec 22.58%, 0xdad8...4b5a 3.75% (active daily), 0x17d1...d005 3.51% (round 34.2M, mostly dormant, last tx 2026-08-10), 0xdc46...61a9 2.05% (round 20M).

E1.value: Next unlock 2026-12-10: 13,888,889 CETUS (Community) = 1.43% of CoinGecko circulating 973.9M (<2%). Note: Binance's product feed gives circulating 630.3M, on which it would be 2.20%; no on-chain evidence was established that CoinGecko's figure is wrong, so CoinGecko is used per §1.

E2.value: Six remaining monthly community unlocks to 2027-05-10 total 79,861,112 CETUS = 8.20% of circulating (all within 180 days); no other emission found (TreasuryCap frozen, supply fixed at 1B).

E3.value: 973,913,043 / 1,000,000,000 max = 97.4% (CoinGecko). On the Binance 630.3M figure it would be 63.0%, still >=30%.

E4.value: Schedule known: 49 monthly events 2023-05-09 to 2027-05-10 (tokenomics.com, matches docs allocation 50/20/15/15).

F1.value: Move package 0x0686...e54b v1 is public bytecode on-chain with a single module 'cetus' exposing only a private init; explorer source verification could not be checked (suiscan.xyz 407).

F2.value: TreasuryCap 0x908dd3b6...54df is Immutable (frozen 2024-11-11, tx 7N5whEtq...), total_supply 1,000,000,000.000000000; GoPlus mintable 0, cap_owner Immutable. No mint path.

F3.value: No privileged roles remain: TreasuryCap and CoinMetadata immutable, no DenyCap/DenyCapV2/RegulatedCoinMetadata objects, UpgradeCap 0xa4c7...d73d (created to deployer 0x34df...02cb) no longer exists (object null), package still at version 1.
F3.source: Sui GraphQL publish tx CqKi5wdU... objectChanges; object(0xa4c7...)

F4.value: Not upgradeable: UpgradeCap destroyed, packageVersions shows only v1; GoPlus contract_upgradeable 0.

F5.value: No blacklist/freeze: no DenyCap for the type; GoPlus blacklist 0. Sui coins have no pause mechanism without a DenyCap.

F6.value: Standard 0x2::coin with no custom transfer logic (module has only init); no taxes, limits or toggles possible.

F7.value: GoPlus Sui returns no honeypot/cannot-sell field (trusted_token 1); GeckoTerminal is_honeypot 'unknown'; honeypot.is does not cover Sui. Structurally no sell restriction is possible (no DenyCap), but no scanner gives the flag.

F8.value: Largest pool USDC/CETUS 0.25% on Cetus CLMM (0x3b13ac70...) has ~$416k of ~$480k listed reserve (>20%); CLMM positions are NFTs, ownership/lock not checked (stopped after D2 hard fail).

F9.value: Unmodified standard Sui 0x2::coin implementation with TreasuryCap frozen and package immutable (Sui analogue of SPL with mint authority revoked).

G1.value: Binance tags ['defi','Seed'], no Monitoring; CETUSUSDT/USDC/TRY TRADING. No spot delisting found on a credible venue (OKX delisted only the perp on 2025-12-26).

G2.value: 2025-05-22 ~$223M exploit (checked_shlw overflow in a shared math library) is >90 days old, with public post-mortem, patch, audits, relaunch 2025-06-08 and compensation plan. No newer exploit found.

G3.value: No enforcement action or team arrest found in a web search; top-20 sanctions screening not done (only top 10 available).

G4.value: No migration or redenomination announced; same coin type since 2023, package v1.
